Defined in: website/components/home/mosaic/burn/front.ts:47

Per-column burn front inside one letter — the paper-space y of the live edge at column x. The front climbs BOTTOM→TOP through the letter's own ink extent (y1 → y0), so a descender's stem burns up from the baseline, not from the paper's bottom edge.

Parameters

s

BurnSession

The live session (its clock animates the edge noise).

L

LetterBurn

The letter whose front is sampled.

x

number

Paper-space column inside the letter (device px).

progress

number

Global burn stage 0..1.

jagAmp

number

Jagged-edge amplitude in device px.

Returns

number
